title: The Hardware Distillery Co.
specs: Spirits aged in basement breathing fresh salt air from Hood Canal
Uses water from Hood Canal Watershed, unchlorinated and unfluoridated
Whiskey made from barley malted with local peat
gap: No tasting or tour offerings described
blurb: The Hardware Distillery manufactures high quality spirits meant to be paired with food. The distillery is located on property sloping to Hood Canal, with a basement aging barrels in fresh salt air. They produce spirits including whiskey and liqueurs such as Little Owl, made with local ingredients.
